-r requirements_base.txt

# CUDA 13.2 / torch 2.11+cu130 / triton 3.6.0 dep set. Keep the TVM FFI
# and Cutlass DSL pins synchronized with CUDA13_EXPECTED_DEPENDENCY_VERSIONS in
# bazel/cuda13_packages.bzl.
# Keep direct wheel URLs synchronized with whl_deps() in
# arch_config/arch_select.bzl.
# First-version scope: torch + torchvision + triton + deep_gemm + deep_ep + flash_mla
# + tilelang + fast_safetensors + fastsafetensors (the last two rebuilt against
# torch 2.11+cu130 and mirrored to the team-managed CUDA 13 bucket).  Other
# torch-ABI-bound wheels (flash_attn, flashinfer-cubin, flashinfer-jit-cache,
# fast_hadamard) are deferred. flashinfer-python remains available for
# JIT-backed APIs. Keep these architecture-specific pins until x86 and ARM are
# qualified on the same Cutlass DSL and TVM FFI releases.
flashinfer-python==0.6.9
nvidia-cutlass-dsl==4.4.2
apache-tvm-ffi==0.1.10

# Core torch stack — wheels mirrored to OSS by us; upstream is
# https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130/.
https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/miji/0430/torch-2.11.0%2Bcu130-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl
https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/miji/0430/torchvision-0.26.0%2Bcu130-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl

# Triton 3.6.0 supports CUDA 13.x ptxas natively (no wrapper needed).
triton==3.6.0

# Self-built CUDA 13 wheels against torch 2.11+cu130 with gcc-toolset-12;
# source revisions are encoded in the filenames.
https://rtp-opensource.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/cuda13/wheels/x86_64/deep-gemm/deep_gemm-2.5.0%2B8a4dfba-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl
https://rtp-opensource.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/cuda13/wheels/x86_64/deep-ep/deep_ep-1.2.1.12%2B37fda1c.base-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl
https://rtp-opensource.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/cuda13/wheels/x86_64/flash-mla/flash_mla-1.0.0%2B9241ae3-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl

# DSV4 mHC uses TileLang by default.  Keep the same version as cuda12_9.
tilelang==0.1.9

# rtp_kernel built from gitlab cuda_extension main (sm_80/90a/100a)
# against torch 2.11+cu130; flashinfer-dependent submodules (xqa,
# sparse_attention*, clustered_gather) are import-tolerant in this build.
https://rtp-opensource.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/cuda13/wheels/x86_64/rtp-kernel/rtp_kernel-0.1.0%2Bcu13.4a1a7e3-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl

# fastsafetensors / fast_safetensors rebuilt against torch 2.11+cu130
# (originals were torch 2.1.2 + cu121).  Project name is `fast-safetensors`
# on PyPI but the import is `fast_safetensors`; both wheels installed.
# Required by --load_method fastsafetensors smoke targets.
https://rtp-opensource.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/cuda13/wheels/x86_64/fast-safetensors/fast_safetensors-0.7.3%2Btorch2.11.cu130-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl
https://rtp-opensource.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/cuda13/wheels/x86_64/fastsafetensors/fastsafetensors-0.1.20%2Bali-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl
# fast_safetensors rebuilt against torch 2.11+cu130.

# Pin safetensors and tabulate for parity with cu12_9 lock.
safetensors==0.6.2
mysql-connector-python==9.4.0
tabulate==0.9.0

# autoawq / auto_gptq / bitsandbytes / peft are torch-ABI-bound; pip will
# resolve compatible versions if available, otherwise we'll see them in
# the lock.  Drop autoawq from cuda13 (no torch 2.11 wheel yet upstream)
# and autoawq-kernels (same).
# auto_gptq      # deferred — torch 2.11 ABI rebuild needed
# autoawq        # deferred
# tensorrt 10.x cu12 series — drop for cuda13 (use TRT-LLM plugins via C++ side).
